Title: Kanji meaning quiz: explicit semantic-pair exclusions through import, cache and filtered pools

Authorization: Owner approved 2026-11-07: "Ok, approve, please proceed" after the proposed narrow prerequisite work item, independent review, implementation and sequential N1 resumption.

Problem: N1 issue stop-cran/learning-japanese#60 batch099 is blocked at execution734 (content309189fc; teaching70dfe334; qualifiedAndroid1c1b7bf4). Native733 production randomN1Subset seeds4/7 show superfluous; redundant (冗) as a wrong option for remainder; surplus amount (剰). Frozen complete KANJIDIC2/JMdict entries and the original two model-family follow-ups support overlapping meanings. Distinct title strings and curated distractors do not protect arbitrary filtered pools.

Scope and proposed contract:
- Optional kanji front matter quiz_exclusions lists exact single-code-point kanji IDs. Omitted/empty preserves legacy behavior. Strict inline-string-list declaration; reject malformed/duplicate/shadowed/self/unsafe/non-character entries. Missing references are checked against the accepted full corpus after duplicate-title filtering, not the current selected pool; skip invalid referring cards with a clear problem, including dangling-reference cascades.
- Either endpoint declaring a pair excludes co-occurrence in the meaning question: target versus distractor and among chosen distractors. Direct, symmetric, non-transitive; do not infer synonyms or transitive cliques. Check curated and tag/random fallback paths; fewer options are allowed without restoring excluded candidates, including target-only in a fully excluded pool consistent with existing word behavior.
- Carry metadata through KanjiCard, Room cache/default-preserving migration, every slim DAO projection, import mapping and BOTH QuizViewModel normal and borrowed-padding mappings. Preserve stable IDs/source/stack, all schedules/logs, full readings and nullable curated readings, ordering, stroke data and unrelated metadata.
- Source-scoped accepted parser epoch for meaning metadata forces reimport even at unchanged remote HEAD/contentVersion and launch throttle; advance only after successful transactional replacement, preserve prior snapshot/epoch on failure. Prefer explicit meaning epoch rather than mislabeling the reading epoch.
- Update authoring validation/tests and both format/design contracts. Author only the evidenced narrow 剰/冗 declaration after the mechanism exists; no speculative bulk exclusions, title distortions, membership/level/readings changes or ignored compatibility fields.
- Optional metadata remains readable by older clients but old clients do NOT enforce the new guard; document the required upgraded compatible client and bounded owner-testing scope honestly. Do not claim existing installed APKs fixed, universal semantic uniqueness, phone/general-release acceptance or a new mandatory schema migration protecting older readers.

Implementation isolation:
- Fresh app worktree/branch based on latest fetched main, currently e46106de. Preserve canonical dirty checkouts and paused N1 trees.
- Independently review plan before implementation; reconcile and post owner comment. Independently review uncommitted implementation before normal signed publication and exact green CI.
- Adopt only the approved narrow prerequisite onto the qualified frozen-production N1 branch as a normal signed backport, with exact delta and regression qualification; do not adopt unrelated newer production/localization behavior.
- Content tools and docs changes integrate current main without overwriting existing N1 evidence. N1 coordinator completes/reviews actual content declaration and integrated native replay before delivering099.

Acceptance:
- Regression replays original saved randomN1Subset pools seeds4/7; prove pre-fix exposure and post-fix removal with the actual titles, both target orientations, one-sided declarations and target outside the supplied pool.
- Curated and fallback candidates, filtered/tag/All pools, direct-not-transitive pairs, distractor-to-distractor pairs, undersized pools, missing curated IDs and unchanged omitted metadata behavior.
- Strict parser and validator agreement for absent/empty/valid supplementary-plane kanji/malformed values, duplicate/shadowed declarations, bad IDs and missing/rejected references. Preserve word metadata semantics.
- Real parse -> Room -> full/slim DAO -> QuizCard -> options mapping; normal and padding VM paths. Migration/reopen preserves existing progress and defaults. Unchanged-HEAD/contentVersion/throttle epoch success/failure tests, source isolation.
- Existing targeted JVM suites, Detekt, lint and boundary/build checks. Existing N1 fresh corpus/font HOST gates at unchanged2g; native099 needs changed baseline replay and original reviewer dependent confirmations.
- Preserve execution734 finding/raw reviewer audit. Claude's9tool-overlap starts contradict its serial-read claim: obtain only necessary compliant dependent confirmation and preserve the original report unchanged. No blind-review credit or repeated-read loop.
- Sequential heavy stages and reviewers, exactlyone writer/atmostone reviewer. No native device/port/process interference; explicit owned-device checks. No signing bypass, force push, heap/archive-budget increase or unreviewed content publication.

Preserve17->18 language columns,18->19 accepted_source, then use SAME19->20 exclusion/meaning-epoch migration and same exported20 identity on both branches. Test frozen17->backport20->main20 reopen, not merely two independent upgrades.

Reconciliation: accepted. Main implementation uses20. Frozen qualification carries only structural main17->19 migrations/entities/default columns required for SAME20 schema compatibility, plus the narrow guard; it does not activate locale/source-selection behavior or adopt unrelated production changes. Verify exact schema20 identity and actual database reopen across both applications. If that structural-only backport cannot be validated, stop rather than invent a divergent version.

Also accepted: saved native733 fixture constructs four-field QuizCards; add metadata to actual fixture mapping before replay. Preserve exact original randomN1Subset membership/order/seeds4/7 and pre-fix output as regression data, not regenerated subsets. Target-only options match existing word behavior; no unrelated session redesign.

Reviewer inspected plan/issue132, main DESIGN/parser/frontmatter/models/builder/Room/sync/VM/Words/migration-test setup, content validator and saved native fixture. No edits/tests/native execution or independent re-verification of dictionary claims. Serial tools reported; actual model unavailable.

Implementation remains authorized by owner "Ok, approve, please proceed". Independent uncommitted code review, tests/static gates/normal signing/exact green CI, qualified frozen backport and necessary native/original-reviewer confirmation remain required before099 delivery.

Independent read-only code review of uncommitted Android e46106de + content d5a376ee changes for issue132. Exact runtime model unavailable. Tools serial; no subagents/edits/publication/native.

Finding132-A (Medium, high confidence): KanjiMeaningMetadata anchor scanning misses comments immediately following quoted scalars. Valid YAML key: &guard "quiz_exclusions"#comment followed by *guard: [月] was accepted by compiled Kotlin with empty exclusions. With whitespace before comment it was rejected. Remedy: recognize closing-quote comment boundary and reject aliased guard, regress both quote styles. Android implementer assigned same-task correction.

Finding132-B (Medium, high confidence): Python exclusion-ID validation omitted Unicode noncharacters while Android rejected them. Actual parse/check_kanji experiment with U+FDD0 and an existing mocked stem had no errors. Remedy: match U+FDD0-FDEF and code points ending FFFE/FFFF; focused agreement regression. Parent corrected predicate and added8noncharacter boundary cases, validation pending.

Remaining qualification: structural-only frozenbackport/sharedschema20/crossapplicationreopen; actual narrow pair declaration/integratednative/originalrenderedconfirmation; originalClaude9tool-overlap deviation remains open.

Inspected relevant ranges/diffs in plan/reconciliation/validationlog, Models/ContentParser/FrontMatter/KanjiMeaningMetadata/QuizBuilder, Database/KanjiApp/ContentSync/SrsMapping/QuizViewModel, their changed tests/schema19/20, appDESIGN/CONTENT-SCHEMA/instructions, contentvalidator/tests/format, savednative099fixture/routeJSON. Not universal fullfile reads, linguistic re-review, phone or generalrelease acceptance.

Dependent narrow independent confirmation: BOTH132-A and132-B RESOLVED, no concrete residual issue found. Reviewer read only relevant implementation/tests and specified prior report/logs, no whole review repeated. A regression failed before fix, then actual rebuilt44parser tests/nofail/error/skips/Detekt passed; bothquote comments and unrelatedquoted#scalars covered. Reviewer independently evaluated current Python predicate against all66noncharacters and19adjacent valid scalar boundaries: correct. Parent content87tests/fullvalidator0errors/diffcheck pass; signed2d3a3fa0/PR63CI42392566316SUCCESS. Exact reviewer runtime model unavailable; no native/fullsuite/backport confirmation or original099review credit.

The reviewed mechanism is published on application main at signed `2edbf366a4a6fce594b2a6580bfc4252b98d3f6d` (PR #133 merged). Its exact-head PR CI [42392821090](https://github.com/stop-cran/kanji-cards-android/actions/runs/42392821090) completed successfully for both core and build. Separate main-push CI 42394221803 was still running at the last verification; its success is not yet claimed.

The companion validator/docs are published on content main at signed `2d3a3fa022d48aca6ea8a2ac629bd7ee66b85f9f` (content PR #63 merged), with both exact-head PR CI 42392566316 and main-push CI 42393132653 successful.

The frozen N1 client now has a normally signed, published qualification branch `n1/issue-132-meaning-exclusions` at `bf30cdead8515739bc0e671d57a54b9a3109dd46`. Its tree is exactly the tested staged tree `8d1d8345da7a862d133f08713d489670d8af67c4`; the old `n1/issue-130-test-loader` branch remains unchanged. This carries the pair guard and necessary schema-only 17->18->19->20 bridges, not unrelated localization or source-authority behavior.

Qualification: 53 selected core + 92 selected app cases passed with no failures/errors/skips; boundary checks and Detekt passed. Room20 is byte-identical to main (identity `39f8edf5a5a58d6c0a4ee0a3e7d55f00`), and an actual frozen17->20 database reopened under main20 with metadata/readings/progress retained. Parent independently verified the scope, schema and closed database hashes.

Parent additionally ran the required fresh signed-head HOST gate: 3 RealContent + 1 RareHan cases, no failures/errors/skips, 41 tasks executed, 4m29s, unchanged 2GiB HOST init, one worker/no parallelism/rerun tasks/in-process compiler. Explicit UTC start, XML freshness, exact case names, source/copy hashes, fixture roots and clean signed heads were verified. This supersedes the earlier staged HOST run's missing explicit-start receipt, without rewriting that history.

The same batch099 checkpoint is authorized to resume, but **099 is not accepted or published**. Next are the supported, source-evidenced one-sided `剰 -> 冗` declaration, a new fixture carrying the metadata, changed-tree semantic/native acceptance, and the necessary compliant dependent rendered confirmation. Original 733/734 evidence and the Claude per-tool-serialization deviation remain preserved and are not retroactively accepted. Original pool membership/order was not captured; regression reconstruction reproduced all16 original choices but is not original-membership proof.

Older clients ignore the field. This remains compatible-client owner testing, not automatic universal synonym detection, physical-phone/general-release acceptance or completion of the full N1 rollout. This issue stays open until the promised adoption/acceptance disposition is recorded.
